title: Duplicating resources and editing them without saving stores incorrect data in them and inspector displays wrong data.
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in:
- v4.4.beta1.official [d33da79d3]
- v4.3.stable.official [77dcf97d8]
- v4.2.2.stable.official [15073afe3]

### System information

Godot v4.3.stable - Windows 10.0.19045 - GLES3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6094) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-6400 CPU @ 2.70GHz (4 Threads)

### Issue description

When setting up a resource, then duplicating that resource an setting it up (a few times) the resource file will have icorrect data in it but display the correct data in the editor. When the project is executed, the incorrect information will be used.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4ab695f9-bf9a-4c32-a93a-72d2f485346a

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a Shortcut resource.
2. Assign it an InputKeyEvent
3. Duplicate that resource
4. Edit that resource InputKeyEvent to be something new.
5. (..repeat 2 or 3 times)
6. Run project.

Shortcuts are assigned wrongly

**Note:** When creating the shortcuts directly (Create New -> Resource) this didn't happen. Issue only occours when duplicating (Ctrl+D).

The Minimal Reproduction Project can't be uploaded in its entirety since the editor will display the correctly stored data on reload.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[shortcut_saving.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18462889/shortcut_saving.zip)
